metadata.title: Workout Partner Support
metadata.description: Find workout partner support that helps you follow through on your PacerGo training plan.

hero.sub: Start with a PacerGo training plan, then find workout partner support when accountability, practical help, or training together would make the session easier to complete.

fit.intro: A workout partner is optional support inside the broader PacerGo loop. AI helps with planning; people help with follow-through.
fit.ai_link: See AI planning on the homepage

items.title: Get direction
items.body: Use AI planning to create a training direction before you start.

items.title: Find support
items.body: Choose workout partner support only when it helps your goal or schedule.

items.title: Train together
items.body: Meet in person for accountability and practical support during the workout.

items.title: Keep going
items.body: Record training activity and continue reviewing progress in PacerGo.

discovery.intro: Partner discovery should help you compare support clearly without mixing level badges, service tags, or verified credentials.

items.title: Browse workout partners
items.body: Review available partner profiles and supported training interests in the Web App.

items.title: Keep credentials separate
items.body: Partner level, service tags, pricing, availability, and verified credentials are separate pieces of information.

items.title: Match support to context
items.body: Choose structured help, experienced peer support, or someone to train with based on what the session needs.

expect.intro: PacerGo helps make the next training step clearer while keeping the choice of human support in your hands.

items.title: Start from your goal
items.body: Use your training direction to decide what kind of support would be useful.

items.title: Stay accountable
items.body: A real person can make it easier to show up and keep the session moving.

items.title: Train with support
items.body: Work out with another person when practical help or shared momentum matters.

items.title: Continue in the app
items.body: Use PacerGo to move from planning into training and progress review.

trust.intro: Meeting someone to train should involve careful judgment. PacerGo provides signals and tools that support safer decisions.

items.title: Profile information
items.body: Review profile details and supported training interests before choosing support.

items.title: Report and block
items.body: Use reporting and blocking tools when a person or interaction creates concern.

items.title: Verification labels
items.body: Verified credentials should appear only when the underlying review supports them.

items.title: Meet thoughtfully
items.body: Use public-venue and session-sharing guidance for in-person workouts.

cta.title_1: Find the support that helps you
cta.sub: AI creates direction, and real people help you follow through.
